reuse.why: Adds the guard inside the existing linkBankSyncAccount that all five provider link handlers already delegate to, using the same db.first query style as the surrounding code.

duplication.why: One query and one throw, written once for every provider.

placement.why: The check sits at the top of the shared link function, before any bank/account/payee write or sync call, which is where this tree centralises linking.

scope.why: Only the guard and focused tests covering each rule in the request.

maintainability.why: Simple and central; the 'already linked' rule is an inline SQL string rather than a named query, which is acceptable given the file's style.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No provider bypasses linkBankSyncAccount; the guard is inside it.

one_place.where: linkBankSyncAccount in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, shared by the goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, akahu and enablebanking link handlers.
